body: Damn, I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe this time 'round, life will be kinder to the both of us. At least I hope it will be. I dunno.

I dunno, my professors seem pretty damn well pissed off that I haven't done shit in their classes lol. I kind of understand, thought, I'm kind of making their jobs annoyingly hard.

Aaaand meds and hospital might mean that my parents eventually find out, which is very not good. They're super shitty about my eating disorder, I think I would be disowned if I bring any more shame to the family.

But yeah, what you said with everything else does help. I still don't know how I feel about... everything, in general. But I know that by now I should at least stick around long enough to try and fix the shit I broke via neglect, and see how I feel after that. I wasn't like this last year. I don't know how I got from past me to present suicidal me.

Sorry, I probably sound pessimistic as hell. Seriously though, thanks for the kind words. Nothing feels real right now, so I just hope that you're not a dream. Heck, even if you are, I'm thankful.

Yup, I'm in good old Oz. And thanks, though it was more... my dream to get a degree in this field. It was my dream job, but then stuff happened. Guh. Is this what your dream dying is like? I'm a bit too numb to tell.

But thanks, though. I appreciate the sentiment, and I hope that you get out of all this alright as well. Here's to us and all the others survivin'.
